title: In Vivo Electrophysiology Recording During Optogenetic Manipulation via UCNPs
protocol: Head-fix mice on a stereotaxic setup.
Place a respiratory mask around the nose and mouth to deliver 1.5% isoflurane for anesthesia during surgery.
Turn down the isoflurane concentration to 0.5% during electrophysiology recording.
Cover the eyes with erythromycin ointment to block environmental light.
Remove the scalp and create a craniotomy window stereotaxically on V1.
Fill the craniotomy with fresh warm sterile buffered saline throughout recordings.
Slowly insert the silicon electrode into V1 at a depth of 0.4-0.6 mm using a micromanipulator.
Record electrical signals at 30 kHz and amplify × 200 by a multichannel data acquisition system.
High-pass filter electrical signals at 300 Hz.
Detect spikes as events exceeding a threshold of 5 × s.d. below the noise level.
Create raster plots and peri-stimulus time histograms (PSTH).
Sort spike waveforms offline using OfflineSorter software.
